+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import typing as t
+
+from .shell_completion import split_arg_string
+
+
+class CompletionCursor(t.TypedDict):
+    """The tokens of a partially typed command line, as returned by
+    :func:`completion_cursor`.
+    """
+
+    #: Tokens that have been fully typed.
+    complete: list[str]
+    #: The token being typed at the end of the line, or an empty string.
+    current: str
+
+
+# groundwork: allow-duplicate wraps split_arg_string to isolate the cursor token
+def completion_cursor(line: str) -> CompletionCursor:
+    """Split a partially typed command line into the tokens that are
+    complete and the token currently being typed, for use by a shell
+    completion UI.
+
+    The line is tokenized like a POSIX shell, handling quotes and
+    backslash escapes. ``#`` is ordinary text, not a comment. A missing
+    closing quote or a trailing escape doesn't fail, the partial token
+    is used as-is.
+
+    If the line ends in whitespace, every token is complete and the
+    current token is empty. Otherwise the last token is current.
+
+    .. code-block:: python
+
+        completion_cursor("git commit -m 'fix")
+        {"complete": ["git", "commit", "-m"], "current": "fix"}
+
+        completion_cursor("git commit ")
+        {"complete": ["git", "commit"], "current": ""}
+
+    :param line: The command line typed so far.
+
+    .. versionadded:: 8.2.2
+    """
+    tokens = split_arg_string(line)
+
+    if not tokens or line[-1:].isspace():
+        return {"complete": tokens, "current": ""}
+
+    return {"complete": tokens[:-1], "current": tokens[-1]}

@@ -0,0 +1,28 @@
+import pytest
+
+from click.completion_cursor import completion_cursor
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("line", "complete", "current"),
+    [
+        ("", [], ""),
+        ("   ", [], ""),
+        ("git", [], "git"),
+        ("git ", ["git"], ""),
+        ("git commit", ["git"], "commit"),
+        ("git  commit\t", ["git", "commit"], ""),
+        ("echo 'a b' c", ["echo", "a b"], "c"),
+        ('echo "a b" ', ["echo", "a b"], ""),
+        ("echo 'my file", ["echo"], "my file"),
+        ('echo "my file', ["echo"], "my file"),
+        ("echo a\\ b", ["echo"], "a b"),
+        ("echo my\\", ["echo"], "my"),
+        ("echo #tag", ["echo"], "#tag"),
+        ("echo a#b # c", ["echo", "a#b", "#"], "c"),
+        ("echo ''", ["echo"], ""),
+        ("echo '' ", ["echo", ""], ""),
+    ],
+)
+def test_completion_cursor(line, complete, current):
+    assert completion_cursor(line) == {"complete": complete, "current": current}
